title: ChopGate — verify the testnet scenes
problemTitle: An agent with a wallet can be talked into paying.
problemBody: If an agent can send funds, injected text that was never in the owner's signed instructions can push it to pay the wrong account, or too much. A refusal has to happen on chain, and it has to pay nothing.
solutionTitle: ChopGate checks an owner-signed mandate, then pays, refuses, or holds.
solutionBody: This is a NEAR testnet contract. Payments that do not match the mandate are refused in a successful transaction that returns a reason code and transfers nothing. Amounts above a review threshold stay in escrow until the owner approves the exact request. This page is a prototype. It is not audited, and it is not on mainnet.
tryTitle: Wallet attack demo: not included in this version
tryBody: This version does not include the wallet demo. The page only reads public RPC. Use the Verify table below.
verifyTitle: Scene transactions, read from archival RPC (recorded copy as fallback).
verifyBody: The table below shows the on-chain verdict, reason, payout, signer, and judge (JEV) fields. It lists the original seven scene transactions (two paid scenes from Run A, with deterministic rules only, and five scene steps from Run B) and the three Run A scene 3 refusals. Each hash links to the testnet explorer. The signer column is the archival RPC transaction.signer_id, which is also the sender_account_id used to look the transaction up. The three scene 3 transactions were signed by cg-tn1-attacker-0626733e.testnet, not by the agent account. Three of the Run B steps carry a live JEV report; the other two are pending-approval signature checks. If the archival RPC cannot be reached, the same fields are shown from a recorded copy stored in this folder.
sourceMixed: Recorded copy (live RPC did not return every transaction)
hashCompareTitle: Contract code_hash compared with the repository wasm
hashCompareLead: NEAR stores code_hash as the wasm sha256 encoded in base58. The two runs used different deployed wasm, and this page does not treat them as the same contract code.
runANote: Deterministic rules only. No rebuild record in the repository ties this wasm to a source commit, so Run A shows the behaviour of the deployed wasm only.
runBNote: Live JEV plus the same class of rules. The recorded wasm is the build of commit 18a89b6 (the deploy used ab5f21e; the only source difference is a native-only file that is not in the wasm). This is not the same on-chain code as Run A.
selectionNote: These ten rows are the seven scene transactions summarized for this page (Run A: two paid scenes; Run B: scene 1, scene 4, and the three scene-5 steps) plus the three Run A scene 3 refusals. The scene 3 signer, read from archival RPC, is cg-tn1-attacker-0626733e.testnet, not the agent. Setup transactions and further refusals are documented in the repository file docs/TESTNET-RPC-CHECK.md.
fontsNote: Latin fonts (Sora, Michroma, IBM Plex Sans, IBM Plex Mono) are bundled in fonts/ under the SIL Open Font License 1.1. See fonts/NOTICE.txt and fonts/OFL.txt. This page does not load Google Fonts. Korean text uses the system Korean font.
footerLimits: Testnet only. Not audited. No mainnet deployment and no real funds. This page only reads public RPC; it never asks for a key.
errRpc: Archival RPC did not return a complete live result, so the recorded copy is shown.
stepA5: owner approval after a failed other-key approval
stepB1: normal payment with a live JEV report
stepB5h: amount above the 0.05 NEAR review threshold (held)
demoTitle: A 96-second walkthrough of the local checks and the testnet scenes.
demoBody: English subtitles are attached. The recording is a testnet prototype walkthrough; it is not a mainnet demo. A text scan of the video frames found no keys, account e-mail addresses or local paths.
stepA3a: owner impersonation (attacker signs with its own key)
jevFromArgs: From the call argument; no tier2_decision event on this transaction.
